security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, documentation links, and local LibreOffice examples. I confirmed the troubleshooting commands that can terminate LibreOffice processes and start a localhost UNO socket because they need clearer safety guidance.

remediation.issue: Troubleshooting command can terminate user processes.
remediation.suggestion: Replace blanket killall guidance with a safer targeted shutdown step and require user confirmation before stopping LibreOffice.

remediation.issue: Local UNO socket guidance lacks safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to bind only to localhost, close the listener after use, and avoid shared machines for socket automation.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not state an execution boundary.
remediation.suggestion: State that command examples require explicit user approval before an AI assistant runs them.

content.value_statement: Spreadsheet workflows often need repeatable conversion, formulas, and report creation. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical LibreOffice Calc guidance for ODS, XLSX, CSV, PDF, and UNO automation.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to create ODS spreadsheets with LibreOffice Calc.
Provides soffice commands for ODS, XLSX, CSV, PDF, and HTML conversion.
Demonstrates Python UNO automation for cells, formulas, and document saving.
Describes ezodf usage for simple ODS file creation.
Lists spreadsheet practices for validation, templates, formulas, and conversion testing.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice or compatible Python libraries to be installed separately.
Does not include executable scripts or packaged automation tools.
UNO examples require a running LibreOffice listener on the expected localhost port.
Conversion quality can vary with complex spreadsheets, macros, charts, and fonts.

use_cases.title: Convert Office Files
use_cases.description: Convert ODS, XLSX, CSV, PDF, and HTML spreadsheet files with repeatable LibreOffice commands.

use_cases.title: Build Spreadsheet Reports
use_cases.description: Create report workbooks with formulas, named ranges, validation, and structured templates.

use_cases.title: Automate Calc Tasks
use_cases.description: Use Python UNO or ezodf examples to create spreadsheets and fill cells programmatically.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Spreadsheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet plan for a small budget. Include sheet names, columns, simple formulas, and the recommended ODS output.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Spreadsheet Formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the safest LibreOffice Calc commands to convert my ODS file to XLSX, CSV, and PDF. Explain expected outputs and checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Formula Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Calc report for monthly sales data. Include formulas, validation rules, conditional formatting, and export recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Plan UNO Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Python UNO workflow that creates a Calc workbook, fills data, adds formulas, saves ODS output, and closes the document safely.

output_examples.input: Convert a spreadsheet from ODS to XLSX and PDF.
output_examples.output: The assistant provides a short command sequence, explains the expected files, and recommends opening both outputs to verify formatting.

output_examples.input: Create a report workbook for quarterly expenses.
output_examples.output: The assistant outlines workbook tabs, column names, summary formulas, validation rules, and an ODS-first storage approach.

output_examples.input: Automate filling cells with Python UNO.
output_examples.output: The assistant describes the UNO connection flow, cell update steps, save behavior, and cleanup actions in plain language.

best_practices: Keep source spreadsheets in ODS format when LibreOffice is the primary editor.
Test converted files before sharing them with users or downstream systems.
Use explicit file paths and user approval before running shell commands.
anti_patterns: Do not run batch conversion commands in a directory without reviewing the matching files.
Do not leave a LibreOffice UNO socket running longer than needed.
Do not assume XLSX, PDF, and CSV exports preserve every formula or format exactly.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps create, convert, and automate LibreOffice Calc spreadsheets using documented commands and Python examples.

faq.question: Does it require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. The command-line workflows require LibreOffice, and UNO automation requires LibreOffice with a running listener.

faq.question: Can it convert XLSX files?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents conversion between ODS, XLSX, XLS, CSV, PDF, HTML, and related spreadsheet formats.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made scripts?
faq.answer: No. It provides examples and workflow guidance, but it does not package executable automation scripts.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What security care is needed?
faq.answer: Confirm shell commands before execution, review batch file matches, and close any local UNO listener after automation.
